text:
noah: quick heads-up — quant2b-v3 canary is showing inconsistent rerank + paraphrase fidelity on the paraphrase-heavy promptset after the last fuzzymerge. can we triage?

priya: numbers?

noah: micro-paraphrase-gold (n=150): paraphrase-fidelity metric down 4.1%, nDCG@5 down 2.2%. human spot-check shows pairs that used to be distinct are now collapsed.

emma: was there a change to merge thresholds or to the fuzzyhash heuristic?

sam (label-ops): we ran fuzzymerge_autopruner v2 with sim_threshold=0.86 last night. it collapsed ~140 paraphrase variants across multiple banks; 31 were previously annotated as distinct gold variants.

priya: could the quant mapping be amplifying small differences? quant2b-v3 did change softmax temperature fallback for perf. but we should isolate dedupe first.

onboard-bot: queued quick qbench: qbench-4109876543-quant2b-dedupe-diff. link: https://ci.internal/runs/4109876543

sam (label-ops): extracting affected gold ids now: pg-3001, pg-3002, pg-3050. creating a fork: paraphrase-gold-restore-31.

noah: nice. run two jobs: quant2b-v3 on merged set and on restored fork; compare paraphrase-fidelity and nDCG@5.

onboard-bot: job A complete: merged-set nDCG@5 delta -2.2%. job B complete: restored-set nDCG@5 delta -0.3%.

emma: that strongly implicates the merge.

priya: process suggestion — add gold flag preserve_variant=true for anchors where multiple labeler variants exist or where paraphrase_significance==high. backfill heuristic: labeler_variant_count>1 OR contains paraphrase_marker tokens.

sam (label-ops): will implement. PR will skip merges when preserve_variant==true. also creating a challenge set paraphrase-variant-challenge-150 to include in onboarding qbench.

noah: gating: require quant brings to pass paraphrase-fidelity delta >= -1.0% on that challenge set or block promotion. add to onboarding checklist.

priya: also snapshot the dedupe commit + goldset for auditability.

onboard-bot: snapshot created: repo@commit:cc7a12b; goldset_s3: s3://goldsets/snapshots/4109876543-cc7a12b.tar.gz

sam (label-ops): PR opened: https://git.internal/p/dedupe/pull/233 — skip merges when preserve_variant==true; includes unit tests and e2e micro-golden smoke. backfill plan: 31 immediate anchors, broader sweep of ~140 candidates in 72h.

emma: hold quant2b-v3 canary until PR merges and gate is active. I'll flag it on the release board.

noah: thanks team. small metadata flag but avoids losing intended paraphrase variants in gold. will follow up when PR lands.

priya: thanks — good catch. :raised_hands:
